decisions: Reuse the existing canonical source discovery, deduplication, mapped SourceText owners and diagnostic path views
Pass the measured stdlib source count to the library emitter instead of omitting standard-library inputs
Retain the existing ordinary Windows/Linux API wrappers and dispatch both through one mapped-source consumer
CSharp Windows linker always includes kernel32 import library; shared Clang consumption likewise requires explicit -lkernel32
Keep the existing byte-safe sys.text.startsWith implementation for CSharp ordinal sys. prefix decisions
Do not repeat the compiler build or emission when only the linker library list changes
